articles.title: From resettlement colony to PG hub: How Satya Niketan was stretched beyond its limits
articles.summary: Satya Niketan, once a quiet resettlement colony in Delhi, has evolved into a bustling student enclave. Following the university's expansion in 1973, the area saw a sharp rise in demand for student housing.

articles.summary: Based in Punjab with journalistic experience of over two decades, Navjeevan Gopal is a senior journalist reporting on crucial issues such as drugs, crime, gangsters, terror and other security issues in the border state. The Punjab Police is one of his core beats.

articles.title: Trophy controversy returns? Mohsin Naqvi to attend India’s Women’s Asia Cup final
articles.summary: Mohsin Naqvi, the chairman of the Pakistan Cricket Board and president of the ACC, is set to attend the Women's Asia Cup final. Should India clinch victory, tensions may arise over trophy presentation, reminiscent of last year when India declined to accept the Men's Asia Cup trophy from Naqvi.

articles.title: Fuentes Criticises Owens Focus: Far-right pundit says she hijacked Kirk tributes; urges return to faith
articles.summary: Nick Fuentes has criticized Candace Owens over her coverage of Charlie Kirk’s death, arguing that the conversation has shifted away from Kirk’s influence on young men. Fuentes said Kirk inspired followers through his faith, work ethic, family values and public message.

articles.title: Pat McAfee has put more than $6 million of his own money into GameDay prizes and charity
articles.summary: An LSU student named Bruce had a chance at a million-dollar reward during a broadcast sponsored by Pat McAfee and Home Depot. Selected randomly from the crowd, he attempted a 33-yard field goal twice but unfortunately missed both shots.

articles.summary: A remarkable 1,100-acre estate on Sonoma Mountain has been sold for an astounding $38.5 million. Entrepreneurs Mark and Debra Leslie have converted this once undeveloped land into a self-sustaining retreat, pouring in $33 million for environmental restoration and diverse farming infrastructures.

articles.title: 'Love and War' teaser to be attached to 'Ramayana'?
articles.summary: Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love and War has wrapped filming and will release in 2027. The film's teaser is now planned for a November 2026 theatrical launch.
